description.value: You cause a small overload of psychic energy within the mind of a creature you can see. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 1d6 psychic damage and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn.\n\nThe spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6),and 17th level (4d6).
